requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 每 5 秒读取 DHT11（D7）温度并串口输出
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: Apply io_3 deltas accumulating past 5000ms repeatedly; vary io_2 (valid/invalid) and provide corresponding io_0/io_1 values; observe serial_0_trigger and serial_0_value_* at each 5s boundary.
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: serial_0_trigger is asserted exactly at each control-step where accumulated elapsed time crosses each 5s boundary; serial_0_value_0/serial_0_value_1 reflect the most recent retained measurement (updated only when io_2 is true); serial_0_value_2 equals true only when the DHT read for that report frame is valid (io_2 true), and false when invalid.
